criteria.description: MUST NOT set defaults during destructuring
criteria.evidence: INTENT CONFIRMED; LITERAL COMMAND NON-PORTABLE. The verifier reproduced the executor's failure: `grep -rzPn ...` → 'grep: invalid option -- P', exit 2 (BSD grep). Because the pass condition is 'returns no matches', the literal probe is an always-passes command here — a real (non-blocking) defect in the criterion, not in the code. Portable substitute scans run by the verifier over packages/luca-core/src/handoff: (1) `grep -rnE "\{[^{}]*[^=!<>]=[^=][^{}]*\}[[:space:]]*="` → 0 matches; (2) `grep -rnE "^[[:space:]]*\}[[:space:]]*="` (formatter-wrapped closer) → 0 matches; (3) `grep -rnE "(const|let|var)[[:space:]]+\{"` → 0 matches, i.e. there is ZERO variable destructuring anywhere in the module; (4) `grep -rnE "\([[:space:]]*\{"` → matches inspected one by one, all object-literal call arguments, no parameter destructuring. Corroborated by a full read of all 16 .ts files: every option is accessed by property (opts.homedir, options.result, filter?.status) and every default lives in the Zod schema (schemas.ts:124-128, 134-139, 166-168, 188, 207-218). Follow-up recommended: rewrite anti-06 portably.
